class.name: JRPGMessageWindow
class.brief_description: The message window: text letter by letter with its control codes, a face, the speaker's name and the pause mark.
class.description: Shows a message as Show Text does: the text, already expanded with [method JRPGMessageText.expand], appears one character a frame at 60 frames a second, with the control codes' colors ([member text_colors]), icons from the icon set, size steps and sizes, positions, waits, instant display and the gold window request ([signal gold_window_requested]). When the text has appeared the window waits for the player, with the pause mark, unless the text ends with [code]\^[/code]; [signal message_finished] is emitted when the player has read it. [code]jrpg_ok[/code] or [code]jrpg_cancel[/code] while the text appears shows the rest at once, up to the next wait for the player (timed waits are skipped too); a click anywhere on the screen counts too (left or right button), unless a control under it takes the click. The window takes input while it has focus, as [JRPGSelectableList] does; it can take the focus only while a message is under way ([method show_message] gives it the focus, and it lets go when the player has read the message). After a long frame the text catches up at most [constant MAX_LETTERS_PER_FRAME] characters a frame. A face is drawn on the left, and the text starts beside it. The speaker's name shows in a small window above the message, or below it when the message is at the top of the screen. The window places itself at the top, middle or bottom of the screen, full width and [constant LINES] lines high, on its frame, on a dimmed band or on nothing. Authority: client. Online, the server sends the text's key and arguments.

method.name: ensure_default_theme
method.description: Adds the message window's defaults (font size, line height) to the default theme under the [code skip-lint]JRPGMessageWindow[/code] theme type, unless they are there already.

method.name: get_background
method.description: Returns the background of the message shown last.

method.name: get_default_text_colors
method.description: Returns Talewright's default text colors: color 0 is normal text, the others are for emphasis, system labels, warnings and gauges.

method.name: get_face
method.description: Returns the face of the message shown last, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_layout
method.description: Returns the laid-out text, in the order it appears: dictionaries with [code]text[/code], [code skip-lint]font_size[/code] and [code]color[/code] (or [code]icon[/code], the icon index), [code]position[/code] (in the text area, which starts inside the window's padding), [code]first[/code] (the first character, counting from 0) and [code]count[/code] (an icon counts as one).

method.name: get_name_box
method.description: Returns the internal window that shows the speaker's name.

method.name: get_placement
method.description: Returns where the message shown last is placed.

method.name: get_shown_characters
method.description: Returns how many characters of the message have appeared (an icon counts as one).

method.name: get_speaker
method.description: Returns the speaker's name of the message shown last.

method.name: get_total_characters
method.description: Returns how many characters the message has (an icon counts as one).

method.name: is_busy
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] from [method show_message] until the player has read the message.

method.name: is_waiting_for_input
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the message waits for the player, at a [code]\![/code] code or at its end.

method.name: show_message
method.description: Shows [param text], with [param face] on the left and [param speaker] in the name box, on [param background], at [param placement]. Opens the window if it is closed and gives it the focus. Control codes are read as [method JRPGMessageText.parse] reads them; expand the codes that stand for game data first.

members.member: The colors of the [code]\C[n][/code] code; color 0 is normal text. An empty array gives [method get_default_text_colors].

signal.name: gold_window_requested
signal.description: Emitted when the text reaches a [code]\$[/code] code: the game shows its gold window.

signal.name: message_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the player has read the message (or at its end, for a message ending with [code]\^[/code]).
